Attractions Near Hutan Pinus Pengger

Kalurahan Terong places Pinus Pengger in the Dlingo pine belt with Becici, Mangunan and Pinus Asri. This page gathers nearby options and how to connect them.

Within the Dlingo pine belt

With Pinus Pengger, Kalurahan Terong lists Puncak Becici, Hutan Pinus Mangunan and Pinus Asri as pine destinations. This helps plan a half-day route in one area.

Detail

Patuk corridor

  • HeHa Sky View is in the Patuk corridor, known for its night view and glass floor.
  • Distances are approximate via hill roads; confirm the route.

Detail

How to connect

Use a self-arranged vehicle to connect destinations. Ask staff or a map for approximate distance and travel time.

Do not pack too many stops in one day; choose 2–3 that fit best.

Frequently asked questions

What places are near Pinus Pengger?

In the Dlingo belt: Puncak Becici, Hutan Pinus Mangunan, Pinus Asri. In the Patuk corridor: HeHa Sky View.

Can they be reached with one vehicle?

Yes, if using a self-arranged vehicle. Public transport does not directly reach the hill stretch.

How far is Puncak Becici?

Distance is approximate and route-dependent; ask staff. See the Puncak Becici page.

Is a full day worth it?

Half a day for 2–3 destinations is enough. See the itinerary page for route options.
